card.name: Digits inside years and numbers
card.fires_on: Digits or the space just before a number, mostly inside years and dates (A.D. 1000, in 1511, 552 C.E.) in history and botany text. Also fires on 'the' or 'in' before a plant family name.

modes.label: Years and dates
modes.description: A digit or space inside a year, often after A.D., B.C.E. or 'in'.
modes.example: Buddhism was introduced from Korea in <<5>>52 C.E., and it spread

modes.label: Other numbers and ranges
modes.description: Digits in numeric ranges or percentages in descriptive text.
modes.example: . Sepals 5, margin entire. Petals 5, white, oblong or lanceolate, slender. Stamens 10–<<2>>0. Ovary inferior or semi-in

modes.label: Words before a plant family
modes.description: 'the' or 'in' just before a botanical family name.
modes.example: - Avoid if allergic to plants in<< the>> Onagraceae family, gamma-l
